data.name: Elias
data.gender_notes: Elias is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Eliyyahu, 'my God is Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-h-w. The prophet Elijah (1 Kings 17). Elias is a Hebrew name meaning “My God is Yahweh”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elias expresses “My God is Yahweh”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Eliyyahu, 'my God is Yahweh'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elias total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
